test-android-emulator:
    # Issue #622 (card DoD): emulator CI job shape for the six mobile
    # channel integration tests (flutter_app/test/integration/
    # mobile_channel_it.dart, tagged `integration`):
    #   IT-flavor-1  — release-manifest audit per flavor
    #   IT-floor-1   — mobile.* availability per tier (issue #19 floor)
    #   IT-observe-1 — hierarchy + screenshot over the channel
    #   IT-gesture-1 — tap / swipe / text injection
    #   IT-shell-1   — Shizuku round-trip (god + opt-in bridge)
    #   IT-consent-1 — consent flow + one-tap disable
    # DISABLED with `if: false` until an emulator runner is provisioned —
    # the hosted pool does not guarantee KVM and a red matrix would gate
    # every release. When provisioned: add
    # `needs: [version, build-android-apks]`, flip the `if` below to
    # `needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success'`, add a
    # download-artifact step for `android-apk-${{ matrix.flavor }}` before
    # the emulator boot, and the job goes green as-is. The same ONE-var
    # rule applies: FLAVOR drives --flavor and FA_FLAVOR.
    name: Android emulator ITs (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: false
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Boot emulator
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -e /dev/kvm || { echo "::error::/dev/kvm missing — the provisioned runner must expose KVM"; exit 1; }
          echo no | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager" create avd \
            -n fa-it --package "system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64" --device pixel_5
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd fa-it \
            -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot -accel on &
          adb wait-for-device
          until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Emulator booted"

      - name: Install flavor APK
        run: adb install -r "flutter_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-$FLAVOR-release.apk"

      - name: Run mobile channel IT suite
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test test/integration/mobile_channel_it.dart --tags integration

  build-ios:
    name: Build iOS IPA
    needs: version
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    # Issue #344: a wedged self-hosted worker (lost completion report)
    # otherwise holds the slot AND the in_progress status until the 300m
    # daily-publish watcher times out; a job-level timeout lets GitHub
    # fail the run server-side and unblock the pool + watchers.
    timeout-minutes: 90

{"content":"name: android-ndk-preseed
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so AGP never auto-installs it
  via sdkmanager mid-configuration. gh-1655: the ci.yml `build-android` leg
  red'd when that unhardened download arrived truncated ("Warning: An error
  occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
  Error on ZipFile unknown archive") — AGP invokes sdkmanager during `:app`
  configuration with NO internal retry, one bad transfer kills the leg and
  the aggregate Quality gate with it. Once `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>`
  exists with a matching source.properties, AGP binds the preseeded NDK and
  its own download path is never entered. The version below MUST equal
  `flutter.ndkVersion` of the pinned Flutter 3.47.x (the `const ndkVersion`
  in packages/flutter_tools/lib/src/android/gradle_utils.dart);
  test/ci_ndk_preseed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides — a
  Flutter bump must move them together. Same hardening class as the
  flutter_gemma Android seed (gh-1468).
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Preseed the pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      env:
        NDK_VERSION: '28.2.13676358'
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        android_sdk="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        sdkmanager="$android_sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        ndk_dir="$android_sdk/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
        # Idempotency: AGP binds exactly this directory when its
        # source.properties carries the requested revision — a warm runner
        # (or a sibling job on the same runner image) must not re-download.
        if [ -f "$ndk_dir/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already present ($ndk_dir) — AGP binds it without a mid-build download"
          exit 0
        fi
        # sdkmanager has NO retry for corrupt downloads: a truncated
        # android-ndk-r28c-linux zip fails the whole gradle configuration
        # (gh-1655). Retry here, verify on disk, and clear any partial
        # unpack between attempts.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "attempt $attempt/3: sdkmanager --install ndk;$NDK_VERSION"
          if yes | "$sdkmanager" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION" \
              > "/tmp/ndk-preseed-$attempt.log" 2>&1; then
            if grep -q "^Pkg.Revision=$NDK_VERSION\$" \
                "$ndk_dir/source.properties"; then
              echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed and verified ($ndk_dir)"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::warning::attempt $attempt installed a tree whose source.properties does not carry Pkg.Revision=$NDK_VERSION"
          else
            echo "::warning::attempt $attempt/3 — sdkmanager ndk;$NDK_VERSION failed:"
            tail -n 5 "/tmp/ndk-preseed-$attempt.log"
          fi
          rm -rf "$ndk_dir"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION failed to install after 3 attempts — failing before gradle re-rolls the same unhardened download"
        exit 1

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

This is the repo precedent: when a mid-build download flaked and red'd the build-android leg, they added a pre-seed action with `curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors`.

The current failure is analogous: AGP/sdkmanager downloads the NDK (android-ndk-r28c-linux) mid-configuration; the download got truncated → "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" → leg red → aggregate Quality gate red.

The durable, in-repo-pattern fix: pre-install the required NDK with retries before `flutter build apk`, so AGP finds it installed and never invokes sdkmanager mid-configuration.

But which NDK version? `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` from the Flutter Gradle plugin. The workflow pins Flutter 3.47.x stable. What NDK does that map to? The log said "Installing NDK (Side by side) 28.2" and the package failed was "NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358" = r28c. So Flutter 3.47.x's flutter.ndkVersion = 28.2.13676358.

Options for the fix:

**Option A: pre-install NDK via sdkmanager with retry loop in build-android job.**
```yaml
- name: Pre-install NDK (retry; gh-1655 sdkmanager truncated-zip flake)
  run: |
    set -euo pipefail
    ndk_dir="$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/28.2.13676358"
    if [ -d "$ndk_dir" ]; then echo "NDK 28.2.13676358 already present"; exit 0; fi
    for attempt in 1 2 3; do
      echo "attempt $attempt: sdkmanager ndk;28.2.13676358"
      if yes | sdkmanager --install "ndk;28.2.13676358" > ndk_install.log 2>&1; then
        exit 0
      fi
      tail -5 ndk_install.log
      sleep 10
    done
    exit 1
```
Caveat: the version is hardcoded and drifts with Flutter bumps. AGP checks ndkVersion — if the preinstalled dir exists with the exact requested version, AGP uses it without invoking sdkmanager. If a future Flutter bump changes flutter.ndkVersion, the pre-install installs a stale NDK but AGP would then try to download its own → back to mid-build download but that's today's behavior; not worse. Also `yes | sdkmanager` accepts licenses.

Actually sdkmanager respects license acceptance state; the runner's preinstalled cmdline-tools usually has licenses pre-accepted (`mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/android/sdk/licenses; echo ...`). AGP itself auto-accepts? AGP's automatic NDK install requires licenses accepted — GitHub runners have all licenses pre-accepted.

**Option B: retry the whole `flutter build apk` step once.** 
```yaml
- name: flutter build apk (debug)
  id: apk
  run: cd flutter_app && flutter build apk --debug --flavor store
```
→ wrap with retry on failure. This covers ANY transient download flake (NDK, gradle artifacts, maven). But it doubles worst-case time (budget ≤8 min warm/15 cold; the leg timeout is 20 min). A retry-with-once is simple and robust. But if the failure is deterministic, retry doubles the cost.

**Option C: don't code-fix; just re-run the failed jobs.** Given the repo convention ("CANCELLED is not a verdict, re-run it"; red 1/3), and given main went green 6 minutes later, a re-run likely goes green. But re-runs are done by the automation (`ai-teammate` bot); do I have rights? I'm logged in as ai-teammate with GH_TOKEN that has workflow scope, so `gh run rerun 38975429686 --failed` would work. However — AGENTS.md line 1802 says "a timed-out PR leg gets ONE empty-commit retrigger — never `gh run rerun`, which reallocates into the same degraded runner pool". That's about the watchdog's handling of timeouts. Hmm — "never gh run rerun" is a strong repo directive for timed-out legs. Our failure is not a timeout though.

Wait, actually — should the rework agent trigger CI re-runs at all? The machine automation (kicker/merge-guard) handles re-runs on push. When I push new commits, CI re-runs automatically on the new head ("CI will re-run automatically after the push — all checks must pass" per ci_failures.md). So pushing ANY commit (even workflow hardening) re-arms validation on the new head. That's the cleanest path: push a fix commit; validation re-runs on the new head fresh.

So the decision: what code/config change do I push?

The failure is NOT caused by the PR's Dart diff — all package legs were green on the red head. The root cause is the NDK mid-configuration download flake inside sdkmanager. The durable fix consistent with repo precedent (gh-1468 seed action, curl --retry patterns, gh-1412 upload retries) is to pre-install the NDK with retries before the gradle build in the build-android leg.

But hold on — scope discipline: rework says "Do NOT refactor unrelated code or add unrequested features". However "Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup" is in scope per the general guidelines flowchart (CONFLICTS → CI → THREADS). The CI failure must be addressed. The most surgical CI fix targeting the exact failure:

1. build-android leg: add a pre-install NDK step with retry.
2. Optionally also nightly.yml/build-mobile.yml use the same pattern? build-mobile.yml has its own Android APK steps (release matrix). The failing leg was ci.yml build-android. Nightly/build-mobile aren't blocking this PR. Scope: fix ci.yml build-android only. Hmm, but "check same pattern across codebase" from formatting_rules — F3: "fix exact issues flagged, then check same pattern across codebase". The same mid-build NDK download exists in build-mobile.yml and nightly.yml android legs. But those aren't failing/blocking. Minimal + thorough: I'd fix the ci.yml leg (the flagged one). Consider whether to share a composite action. Given repo precedent (flutter-gemma-android-seed composite action shared across 3 workflows), a small composite action `android-ndk-preseed` could be shared. But adding files adds surface; a step with retry inline in ci.yml is surgical. Hmm — but build-mobile.yml's release builds would hit the same flake (it builds APKs at release time...). Let me keep focused: fix the failing leg; note the pattern.

Actually wait. Let me reconsider Option B (retry the whole build step). The AGP NDK auto-install doesn't always fail — it succeeded in many runs (including 22:29 main). The flake is transient network truncation. A pre-install with retry is the targeted mitigation and also speeds the build when the runner lacks the NDK. But there's a subtlety: sdkmanager downloads the NDK too — same network. With --retry semantics, transient truncation is absorbed (retry fetches again). The AGP/sdkmanager mid-build invocation has NO retry (sdkmanager does retry? apparently not for corrupt zips).

Another angle: does the runner image have NDK preinstalled? ubuntu-24.04 runner images include Android NDK (usually multiple versions). The image 20261012.334 — let me check the included software. The log shows sdkmanager decided to INSTALL NDK 28.2.13676358 — meaning it wasn't present. Let me check the runner-images readme for that release... From the log: "Included Software: https://github.com/actions/runner-images/blob/ubuntu24/20261012.334/images/ubuntu/Ubuntu2404-Readme.md". I could fetch it, but network access to github.com works (gh CLI works). Let me check what NDK versions that image ships.

Actually, a more robust approach that avoids version hardcoding: let Gradle itself resolve flutter.ndkVersion and pre-install THAT with retry. E.g., in the pre-step:

```bash
cd flutter_app/android
# read NDK version the same way AGP does: from the Flutter gradle plugin
```
That's complex (requires gradle invocation → circular). Alternative: query `flutter` for its ndk version? There's no direct CLI. Flutter's packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension... default ndkVersion. Hard to extract cheaply.

Simplest robust: hardcode 28.2.13676358 with a comment tying it to the pinned Flutter 3.47.x (flutter.ndkVersion), install with retry if missing; AGP then finds it and skips its own download. If Flutter bumps later and the preinstalled NDK mismatches, AGP falls back to its current behavior (auto-install, unhardened) — no regression, and the mismatch would be visible (sdkmanager runs mid-build again). Add a guard test? There's `test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` precedent — a Dart test asserting the workflow contains the seed step and that the pinned version matches... but matching flutter.ndkVersion from a test would require parsing Flutter so…

The root cause is clear: AGP's mid-configuration NDK download (`sdkmanager` fetching `android-ndk-r28c-linux`) got a truncated zip → leg red → aggregate Quality gate red. This repo has an established hardening pattern for exactly this class of failure (gh-1468: pre-seed downloads with `--retry` before the build). # listing lane replaces the whole image set per locale + device type
      # (supply appends, which is how a stale rejected screenshot survived
      # on the live listing) and verifies the committed state via
      # edits.images.list. Runs after the AAB upload so a release train
      # never ships a binary against a stale listing.
      - name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the listing deploy."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Deploying the Play listing (texts + images)..."
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # gh-1468: same seed as the ci.yml/ci AAB jobs — the flavor matrix
      # runs the same flutter_gemma_litertlm hook download per leg.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-gemma-android-seed

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}

test-android-emulator:
    # Issue #622 (card DoD): emulator CI job shape for the six mobile
    # channel integration tests (flutter_app/test/integration/
    # mobile_channel_it.dart, tagged `integration`):
    #   IT-flavor-1  — release-manifest audit per flavor
    #   IT-floor-1   — mobile.* availability per tier (issue #19 floor)
    #   IT-observe-1 — hierarchy + screenshot over the channel
    #   IT-gesture-1 — tap / swipe / text injection
    #   IT-shell-1   — Shizuku round-trip (god + opt-in bridge)
    #   IT-consent-1 — consent flow + one-tap disable
    # DISABLED with `if: false` until an emulator runner is provisioned —
    # the hosted pool does not guarantee KVM and a red matrix would gate
    # every release. When provisioned: add
    # `needs: [version, build-android-apks]`, flip the `if` below to
    # `needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success'`, add a
    # download-artifact step for `android-apk-${{ matrix.flavor }}` before
    # the emulator boot, and the job goes green as-is. The same ONE-var
    # rule applies: FLAVOR drives --flavor and FA_FLAVOR.
    name: Android emulator ITs (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: false
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Boot emulator
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -e /dev/kvm || { echo "::error::/dev/kvm missing — the provisioned runner must expose KVM"; exit 1; }
          echo no | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager" create avd \
            -n fa-it --package "system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64" --device pixel_5
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd fa-it \
            -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot -accel on &
          adb wait-for-device
          until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Emulator booted"

      - name: Install flavor APK
        run: adb install -r "flutter_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-$FLAVOR-release.apk"

      - name: Run mobile channel IT suite
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test test/integration/mobile_channel_it.dart --tags integration

  build-ios:
    name: Build iOS IPA
    needs: version
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    # Issue #344: a wedged self-hosted worker (lost completion report)
    # otherwise holds the slot AND the in_progress status until the 300m
    # daily-publish watcher times out; a job-level timeout lets GitHub
    # fail the run server-side and unblock the pool + watchers.
    timeout-minutes: 90

description: >-

description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so AGP never auto-installs it
  via sdkmanager mid-configuration. gh-1655: the ci.yml `build-android` leg
  red'd when that unhardened download arrived truncated ("Warning: An error
  occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
  Error on ZipFile unknown archive") — AGP invokes sdkmanager during `:app`
  configuration with NO internal retry, one bad transfer kills the leg and
  the aggregate Quality gate with it. Once `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>`
  exists with a matching source.properties, AGP binds the preseeded NDK and
  its own download path is never entered. The version below MUST equal
  `flutter.ndkVersion` of the pinned Flutter 3.47.x (the `const ndkVersion`
  in packages/flutter_tools/lib/src/android/gradle_utils.dart);
  test/ci_ndk_preseed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides — a
  Flutter bump must move them together. Same hardening class as the
  flutter_gemma Android seed (gh-1468).
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Preseed the pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      env:
        NDK_VERSION: '28.2.13676358'
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        android_sdk="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        sdkmanager="$android_sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        ndk_dir="$android_sdk/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
        # Idempotency: AGP binds exactly this directory when its
        # source.properties carries the requested revision — a warm runner
        # (or a sibling job on the same runner image) must not re-download.
        if [ -f "$ndk_dir/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already present ($ndk_dir) — AGP binds it without a mid-build download"
          exit 0
        fi
        # sdkmanager has NO retry for corrupt downloads: a truncated
        # android-ndk-r28c-linux zip fails the whole gradle configuration
        # (gh-1655). Retry here, verify on disk, and clear any partial
        # unpack between attempts.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "attempt $attempt/3: sdkmanager --install ndk;$NDK_VERSION"
          if yes | "$sdkmanager" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION" \
              > "/tmp/ndk-preseed-$attempt.log" 2>&1; then
            if grep -q "^Pkg.Revision=$NDK_VERSION\$" \
                "$ndk_dir/source.properties"; then
              echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed and verified ($ndk_dir)"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::warning::attempt $attempt installed a tree whose source.properties does not carry Pkg.Revision=$NDK_VERSION"
          else
            echo "::warning::attempt $attempt/3 — sdkmanager ndk;$NDK_VERSION failed:"
            tail -n 5 "/tmp/ndk-preseed-$attempt.log"
          fi
          rm -rf "$ndk_dir"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION failed to install after 3 attempts — failing before gradle re-rolls the same unhardened download"
        exit 1

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

The current failure is analogous: AGP/sdkmanager downloads the NDK (android-ndk-r28c-linux) mid-configuration; the download got truncated → "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" → leg red → aggregate Quality gate red.

The durable, in-repo-pattern fix: pre-install the required NDK with retries before `flutter build apk`, so AGP finds it installed and never invokes sdkmanager mid-configuration.

But which NDK version? `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` from the Flutter Gradle plugin. The workflow pins Flutter 3.47.x stable. What NDK does that map to? The log said "Installing NDK (Side by side) 28.2" and the package failed was "NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358" = r28c. So Flutter 3.47.x's flutter.ndkVersion = 28.2.13676358.

Options for the fix:

**Option A: pre-install NDK via sdkmanager with retry loop in build-android job.**
```yaml
- name: Pre-install NDK (retry; gh-1655 sdkmanager truncated-zip flake)
  run: |
    set -euo pipefail
    ndk_dir="$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/28.2.13676358"
    if [ -d "$ndk_dir" ]; then echo "NDK 28.2.13676358 already present"; exit 0; fi
    for attempt in 1 2 3; do
      echo "attempt $attempt: sdkmanager ndk;28.2.13676358"
      if yes | sdkmanager --install "ndk;28.2.13676358" > ndk_install.log 2>&1; then
        exit 0
      fi
      tail -5 ndk_install.log
      sleep 10
    done
    exit 1
```

# listing lane replaces the whole image set per locale + device type
      # (supply appends, which is how a stale rejected screenshot survived
      # on the live listing) and verifies the committed state via
      # edits.images.list. Runs after the AAB upload so a release train
      # never ships a binary against a stale listing.
      - name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the listing deploy."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Deploying the Play listing (texts + images)..."
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # gh-1468: same seed as the ci.yml/ci AAB jobs — the flavor matrix
      # runs the same flutter_gemma_litertlm hook download per leg.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-gemma-android-seed

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}

test-android-emulator:
    # Issue #622 (card DoD): emulator CI job shape for the six mobile
    # channel integration tests (flutter_app/test/integration/
    # mobile_channel_it.dart, tagged `integration`):
    #   IT-flavor-1  — release-manifest audit per flavor
    #   IT-floor-1   — mobile.* availability per tier (issue #19 floor)
    #   IT-observe-1 — hierarchy + screenshot over the channel
    #   IT-gesture-1 — tap / swipe / text injection
    #   IT-shell-1   — Shizuku round-trip (god + opt-in bridge)
    #   IT-consent-1 — consent flow + one-tap disable
    # DISABLED with `if: false` until an emulator runner is provisioned —
    # the hosted pool does not guarantee KVM and a red matrix would gate
    # every release. When provisioned: add
    # `needs: [version, build-android-apks]`, flip the `if` below to
    # `needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success'`, add a
    # download-artifact step for `android-apk-${{ matrix.flavor }}` before
    # the emulator boot, and the job goes green as-is. The same ONE-var
    # rule applies: FLAVOR drives --flavor and FA_FLAVOR.
    name: Android emulator ITs (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: false
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Boot emulator
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -e /dev/kvm || { echo "::error::/dev/kvm missing — the provisioned runner must expose KVM"; exit 1; }
          echo no | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager" create avd \
            -n fa-it --package "system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64" --device pixel_5
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd fa-it \
            -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot -accel on &
          adb wait-for-device
          until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Emulator booted"

      - name: Install flavor APK
        run: adb install -r "flutter_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-$FLAVOR-release.apk"

      - name: Run mobile channel IT suite
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test test/integration/mobile_channel_it.dart --tags integration

  build-ios:
    name: Build iOS IPA
    needs: version
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    # Issue #344: a wedged self-hosted worker (lost completion report)
    # otherwise holds the slot AND the in_progress status until the 300m
    # daily-publish watcher times out; a job-level timeout lets GitHub
    # fail the run server-side and unblock the pool + watchers.
    timeout-minutes: 90

  configuration with NO internal retry, one bad transfer kills the leg and
  the aggregate Quality gate with it. Once `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>`
  exists with a matching source.properties, AGP binds the preseeded NDK and
  its own download path is never entered. The version below MUST equal
  `flutter.ndkVersion` of the pinned Flutter 3.47.x (the `const ndkVersion`
  in packages/flutter_tools/lib/src/android/gradle_utils.dart);

  Flutter bump must move them together. Same hardening class as the
  flutter_gemma Android seed (gh-1468).
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Preseed the pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      env:
        NDK_VERSION: '28.2.13676358'
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        android_sdk="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        sdkmanager="$android_sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        ndk_dir="$android_sdk/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
        # Idempotency: AGP binds exactly this directory when its
        # source.properties carries the requested revision — a warm runner
        # (or a sibling job on the same runner image) must not re-download.
        if [ -f "$ndk_dir/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already present ($ndk_dir) — AGP binds it without a mid-build download"
          exit 0
        fi

        # android-ndk-r28c-linux zip fails the whole gradle configuration
        # (gh-1655). Retry here, verify on disk, and clear any partial
        # unpack between attempts.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "attempt $attempt/3: sdkmanager --install ndk;$NDK_VERSION"
          if yes | "$sdkmanager" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION" \
              > "/tmp/ndk-preseed-$attempt.log" 2>&1; then
            if grep -q "^Pkg.Revision=$NDK_VERSION\$" \
                "$ndk_dir/source.properties"; then

              exit 0

            echo "::warning::attempt $attempt installed a tree whose source.properties does not carry Pkg.Revision=$NDK_VERSION"
          else
            echo "::warning::attempt $attempt/3 — sdkmanager ndk;$NDK_VERSION failed:"
            tail -n 5 "/tmp/ndk-preseed-$attempt.log"
          fi
          rm -rf "$ndk_dir"
          sleep 10
        done

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1
